content_rights: Pocket Daily contains only original interface text, study examples and an original welcome guide; users provide their own DRM-free books and study packs. Official reader firmware updates are fetched from the project repository on request.
app_privacy_answer: No, we do not collect data from this app
hardware_required: Reading needs no hardware. A separately obtained X3/X4-class device running Pocket Daily or compatible CrossPoint-based firmware is required for the companion features (live transfer and reader settings). Built-in demo mode shows the companion without hardware.
